Members

(module scope)

A portfoliolist entry as stored in pages/home — link joins to project routes and featured drives awards-carousel/highlight behavior; the index signature passes through extra CMS fields untouched.

(module scope)

The pages/home Firebase node — portfoliolist is the project list (Firebase returns keyed objects or arrays depending on insertion order); other nodes flow through the index signature.

(module scope)

The pages/about Firebase node — mentions is the intro copy and mention_items the awards/mentions rows consumed by AwardsMentions.
